title: See Barcelona from the Sky
text: The cable car tour gives you the chance to enjoy the city from a unique and beautiful perspective. I recommend buying your tickets in advance to avoid waiting in a queue upon arrival.
author: Jimmie_M

title: The views were amazing...
text: The views were amazing and it was very easy to navigate the self guided tour. The staff were very helpful.
author: John_Y

title: Beautiful views of the...
text: Beautiful views of the city and a historical overview of the mountaintop fortress. A lovely way to see Lisbon!
author: Stacey_H

title: Great views
text: Very easy to book tickets. Minimal queues. Felt safe. Great views across all of Barcelona from the top. Recommend stopping on the way back at the park- we had our picnic here and the kids had a great time.
author: Braveelephant

title: Views & history!
text:
An excellent way to see Barcelona from up high and learn about the city's history. It is well worth paying the price to enter the castle at the top of the hill.
Don't be put off by the length of the line waiting to get on the cable car. It moves quickly.
author: Lorraine J

title: Montjuic cable car ride
text: We came with pre purchased tickets which facilitated out trip.  There is a ticket machine where you can purchase the cable tickets.  I’m assuming you can get the castle tickets too.  The line was daunting but surprisingly fast.  The cable cars hold 6 and they will double you with another party.  This was nice as we were able to photograph each of us without the silly selflie picture.  The ride was incredibly smooth until it turned.  Switching the cables I guess.    Gorgeous views of the city of Barcelona below.  There is plenty to see: castle, cannon, green space even saw archery going on.
author: avicky

title: Ride in the air
text:
Good solution for going up to visit Monjuic Castle.
We saw Barcelona in 360°
We took lots of photos.
author: 733fr_d_rice

title: Pretty views of Madrid
text: We enjoyed the self-guided cable car tour. It is a nice way to see the city of Madrid. Pretty views. It stops off at the top at a castle. You will need to purchase an additional ticket to tour the inside of the castle.
author: Linda_V

title: Amazing Experience!
text: My partner and I loved this trip! The view was amazing! We enjoyed the audio guide a lot as it has so interesting stories and it was simple to use it and experience the most of our visit! thank you keep it up. We will be back again!
author: Kapa_P

title: I really enjoyed this...
text: I really enjoyed this tour, it was simple, fun 😊 and interesting. I was not tired with overflowing information, they kept it just right.
author: Mikros_B
